caption: The drawing depicts a single large ceramic pot, rendered in neutral tones with mostly beige and light brown colors, and some subtle shading to convey its cylindrical shape. The pot features two small handles on opposite sides near the upper rim. On the surface of the pot, there is text written in blue reading “WM. E. WARNER MANUFACTORY WEST TROY.” Below this inscription, there is a drawn number "3" inside a circle, also in blue, and an adjacent decorative blue pattern with a swirling design. The inside of the pot is brown with a visible lip, and the overall appearance suggests a stoneware or earthenware material. The drawing rests on a plain, light tan background with a small horizontal scale and a signature in the lower right corner reading "chas. Cuscau."
title: Crock
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
